raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made the mistake in its analysis of the problem by incorrectly identifying the nervous system as the body system that protects the brain from getting bumped. The Planner misunderstood the role of the nervous system, which is responsible for transmitting signals and coordinating bodily functions, not providing physical protection. The correct answer is the skeletal system, as the skull (part of the skeletal system) provides physical protection to the brain. The error occurred because the Planner failed to accurately consider the protective role of the skeletal system in this context.
